comment: The negative variants that today's tools can run, on the layered rendition (wave 014, W-9; the cases of the plateaus of waves 008 to 013, N1 to N6 and N11 to N15, went with them, and N41 is the key itself). Each case is Brightcart's layered/ with the alteration `ops` (replace: the text must occur once or more, the first occurrence is replaced; write; copy; delete; paths are relative to the folder). Nothing negative is committed as a workspace: BrightcartNegativeCasesTest.java (command line) and brightcart-negative.test.js (editor) build each altered folder in a temporary folder from layered/ and check `cli` and `editor` below. `cli`: the arguments after `archicode -w <workspace>`, the exit code and the lines of the error output (one `error:` line, or a warning line, and no stack trace); `sameStdoutAs`: another command whose standard output is the same. `editor`: the plateau the page draws (null: none is asked for) and what it compares it with (`@past`: the plateau it overrides), then what it shows: fatalError, treeProblems (the tree of the plateaus), layerProblems (what the first layer of the chain that is wrong says), baselineProblem, manifestErrors (file -> text), danglingRelationships, duplicates, warnings (those of the comparison). A mistake in a manifest that holds elements makes the elements it declares missing, which the page also says in layerProblems (the command line stops at the first sentence). An entry `editor: null` has a `reason`: the page has nothing to type, or does not say it yet.
